title: Story premise EDU111: The Gear Neighbors Turn Apart
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (practical mechanisms). Hook: Why does the next wheel turn the other way? Takeaway/theme: Each external-gear mesh reverses rotational direction in the idealized model.
description: A toy machine wants two visible dials to rotate together, but directly meshed external gears turn in opposite directions. Adding a reviewed idealized idler changes the direction relationship and makes the transmission path visible.
